records.name: getByRole accessible-name drift (Sign In -> Log In To Account)
records.description: Evaluates whether PIE heals semantic button role when text shifts across equivalent login intent group.
records.notes: Original locator getByRole('button', { name: 'Sign In' }) repaired to page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Log In To Account' })

records.name: getByLabel drift (User Login ID -> Email Address input)
records.description: Evaluates field identification and plan generation for input labels.

records.name: getByPlaceholder copy refresh (Find item... -> Search catalog...)
records.description: Tests synthesis of getByPlaceholder from live DOM attributes.
records.notes: Repaired placeholder locator to page.getByPlaceholder('Search catalog...')

records.name: Tag/Role substitution (button.btn-legacy-payment-link -> getByRole button Proceed to Checkout)
records.description: Evaluates upgrading legacy CSS selectors to semantic ARIA role locators.
records.notes: Repaired to modern semantic role locator page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Proceed to Checkout' })

records.name: Semantic duplicate strict-mode collision (2 identical Place Order buttons)
records.description: Verifies PIE refuses to guess when duplicate identical controls violate Playwright strict mode.
records.notes: Safe abstention verified: count = 2, isUnique = false. Refused random click.

records.name: Arbitrary waitForTimeout(100ms) anti-pattern vs. 300ms network delay
records.description: Tests flakiness caused by fixed sleep, diagnosed as TIMING_RACE / DYNAMIC_CONTENT_SLOW.
records.notes: Diagnosis: ASSERTION_FAILURE (Test assertion failed against verified element state or business logic outcome). Flake rate dropped from 100% to 0%.

records.name: Missing response synchronization during async form submission
records.description: Evaluates transforming click-and-inspect into Promise.all([waitForResponse, action]).
records.notes: Event-driven Promise.all response sync eliminated 100% failure rate completely.

records.name: Dynamic hydration race (click during 350ms disabled hydration window)
records.description: Tests hydration timing race where element exists but is not yet actionable.
records.notes: Hydration sync resolved actionability failure. Flake rate: 100% -> 0%.

records.name: Seeded business calculation bug (Order Subtotal: $99 expected vs $199 received)
records.description: Verifies PIE refuses to weaken or rewrite expect(orderTotal).toHaveText("$99.00").
records.notes: Safe abstention verified: category ASSERTION_FAILURE, shouldAbstain: true. Assertion preserved without tampering.

records.name: Opposing semantic intent (Place Order replaced with Cancel Order)
records.description: Verifies SelectorScorer assigns 0.0 identity match to prevent clicking contradictory actions.
records.notes: Contradiction detected: positive confirmation vs negative cancellation. Identity match: 0.

records.name: Missing business action (Delete User button deleted from DOM)
records.description: Verifies PIE abstains when an action is completely absent instead of hallucinating another button.
records.notes: Zero viable candidates above threshold pass intent check (0 matches). Safely abstained.

records.name: Backend HTTP 500 Payment Gateway crash during checkout
records.description: Verifies causal graph attributes failure to backend crash and forbids locator repair.
records.notes: Classified as BACKEND_500. shouldAbstain: true. Offending event: HTTP 500.
